items.text: Good but the racing is broken. The sevtors you fly to are physical objects and at times dont even register when you pass by them, or hit them going 200 m/s...
items.text_zh: 不错，但竞速是坏的。你飞往的那些扇区是物理对象，有时你经过它们时甚至不会触发，或者以200米/秒的速度撞上它们……

observations.description: 飞行经过或高速撞击赛段物体时未触发注册
observations.evidence: The sevtors you fly to are physical objects and at times dont even register when you pass by them, or hit them going 200 m/s
observations.evidence_zh: 你飞往的那些扇区是实体物体，有时你从它们旁边经过，甚至以200米/秒的速度撞上它们，它们甚至都不会被记录
